result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: delivery metadata text overlaps and becomes unreadable on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time and delivery fee text collide, rendering as '25–30delivery · Ramen' with the time unit missing/overlapped, so the delivery details are unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Give the delivery time and delivery fee separate spacing or a single non-overlapping text flow (e.g., '25–30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') so the strings do not occupy the same position.
